> import re
> import json
> import codecs

> def decode_bytes(data):
>     encodings = ['utf-8', 'utf-16', 'utf-32', 'utf-16-le', 'utf-16-be', 'ascii', 'iso-8859-1', 'us-ascii']
>     for enc in encodings:
>         try:
>             return data.decode(enc)
>         except UnicodeDecodeError:
>             continue
>     # If none works, split by newline and parse
>     lines = data.split(b'\n')
>     rows = []
>     for line in lines:
>         line = line.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
>         line = line.strip()
>         if not line:
>             continue
>         match = re.match(r'^(\w+)!\s+(\w+)$', line)
>         if match:
>             word, value = match.groups()
>             rows.append({'word': word, 'value': value})
>         else:
>             print(f'Warning: line does not match pattern: {line}')
>     return rows
